Collect diagnostics for a bug report into one redacted file.

Writes a Markdown file with the Pomme version and install method, this Mac's macOS version, model, memory, and free disk space, and the last error that pomme reported. For a VM, named or taken from the last error, it adds the `pomme inspect` output, the end of the current and previous helper logs, and recent guest logs when the guest agent is connected. Pomme replaces your home directory with ~ and withholds lines that mention a token, password, or secret. Review the file before you share it. Pomme never uploads it.

```text
pomme bug-report [NAME] [--output OUTPUT] [--json] [--format FORMAT] [--debug] [--progress PROGRESS]
```

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `NAME` | VM name. Defaults to the VM in the last error, if any. |

| Flag | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--output OUTPUT` | File to write. Defaults to pomme-bug-report-DATE.md in the current directory. |

This command also accepts the [common flags](/reference/cli/#common-flags).
